title: Define release windows and ops playbook for Private (VPC/on-prem) enterprise features
creator: Elena Morales
description: Goal: Produce a firm release window schedule plus an operational runbook for all Private deployment enterprise features planned for the next quarter (VPC, on-prem packaging, customer-managed control plane). This ticket scopes the cross-functional work needed to: 1) set firm dates for feature deliveries and GA windows; 2) define canary and rollback criteria; 3) document upgrade and migration playbooks for customers (both VPC and on-prem); 4) identify compliance/security gating (KMS/HSM, audit logs) and required gating steps; 5) align GTM + CSM communications and post-release support model.
acceptance_criteria: A published release calendar (dates + owners) covering alpha -> canary -> GA for each Private feature
An ops playbook describing canary targeting, rollout cadence, rollback steps, and metrics for abort/continue decisions
Customer migration guide drafts for VPC and on-prem packaged installs with pre-checklists and post-upgrade verification steps
Security/compliance checklist with sign-off owners (Security, Legal) and identified blockers resolved or risk-accepted
CSM/GTM announcement plan and support SLA matrix drafted and reviewed by sales and success
Linked engineering tickets and release branches created with clear dependencies and test coverage requirements
comments: 2026-01-18 - Elena Morales: Kickoff meeting notes posted to Confluence. Action: eng to provide rough estimates for upgrade orchestration and packaging. (link above).

2026-01-22 - Marcus Vega: Engineering provided initial breakdown; major workstreams: installer UX, DB migration tooling, KMS integration. Estimate moved from 13 to 8 points after scope trim (see ENG-4098).
2026-02-02 - Priya Kumar (Security): Requested threat model for the private control plane; flagged HSM onboarding as a blocker until compliance sign-off. Added security checklist to attachments.

2026-02-14 - Carlos Diaz (SRE): Proposed canary metric thresholds: 99.9% request success, p95 latency within 1.15x baseline, and no more than 2 customer-facing incidents in 72h. Added Grafana dashboard link.
2026-02-25 - Design Review (Anika Patel): Updated admin console flows for on-prem upgrade approval. Minor UX changes required; will deliver mocks by 2026-03-05.
2026-03-05 - Marcus Vega: Draft ops playbook uploaded. Request PM review for communications plan and customer-facing migration guide content.

2026-03-09 - Elena Morales: Reviewed ops playbook and added GTM sequencing. Recommended including canned rollback scripts and an emergency cutover checklist. Scheduling the cross-functional sign-off meeting for 2026-03-15.
next_steps: Finalize canary targeting criteria with SRE and create automated gates in the deploy pipeline
Complete on-prem installer test matrix and include a dry-run mode for customer validation
Obtain security sign-off on HSM/KMS integration plan or capture risk acceptance
Publish customer migration guide and coordinate with CSM for pilot customers
Prepare internal runbook training session for support and sales ops (schedule week of 2026-04-20)
notes: Trade-offs discussed: aggressive GA targets increase revenue visibility but raise risk of regressions for complex on-prem installs. We pared scope to focus GA on VPC-managed control plane first and ship on-prem as opt-in beta.
Decision: Shipping order will be: 1) VPC private control plane GA, 2) packaged on-prem beta (opt-in), 3) full on-prem GA pending HSM compliance sign-off.
Mitigations: Extended canary windows for initial VPC customers and scheduled rollback rehearsals with SRE team.
